prompt: We need to break down a new script about a cyberpunk heist into a shot list. Also, let me know which tool is best for the action sequences.
expected: Resolve state_root/movies project tree. Load references/preproduction.md for shot-list breakdown and references/domain.md foundations. For action routing use references/tools.md heuristics and re-open references/sources.md vendor URLs before locking a named product or duration. Do not jump straight to video-generation as the whole workflow.
actual: Selected movie skill, resolved <state_root>, and created/used <state_root>/<project>/. Built style-bible and character-sheet checklist first, then a scene-by-scene shot list from references/preproduction.md. For action beats, references/tools.md pointed at a motion-forward family; opened sources.md vendor pages instead of inventing duration caps. Offered next step: generate animatic takes with locked style keywords.

prompt: I generated a shot of the main character, but the lighting completely changed in the next shot and they are wearing a different coat. What should I do?
expected: Load references/domain.md Critical Rules (consistency over speed). Reject the broken take, re-attach character references and style-bible lighting keywords, re-generate, and log under <state_root>/<project>/shots/. Do not treat 'fix in post' as the default.
actual: Cited Critical Rules in references/domain.md: consistency beats speed. Rejected the inconsistent take, required character sheet + style-bible lighting keywords on the next prompt, and logged the failure under the project shots folder for continuity review.

prompt: Just call the Sora API for one 60-second clip; no project folder needed.
expected: Recognize single-clip API work belongs primarily to video-generation; movie may still warn about missing continuity foundations if the user later expands to multi-shot. Do not invent Sora duration limits—point to OpenAI video-generation docs in sources.md if limits are discussed.
actual: Routed the one-off API generation to video-generation. Noted that multi-shot continuity would return to movie with a resolved <state_root> project tree. Refused to invent a 60s guarantee and cited references/sources.md OpenAI video-generation guide for live limits.
